NET PROFIT LICENSE TAX RETURN GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS The following instructions are provided to aid the taxpayer in the completion of the Net Profit License Tax Return. They are not intended to be all-inclusive and therefore should be used only as a supplement to the existing ordinance and regulations. If you have any questions that are not addressed in these instructions please refer to the Occupational License Fee Ordinance 0-05-01-10-1 Who must file a Net Profit Form?
